parameters.name: Filesystems
parameters.description:
The collection of file system IDs.

>  The maximum number of elements in the set must be less than or equal to 20.

sub_parameters.name: FileSystemId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the CPFS for Lingjun file system. Must start with `bmcpfs-`. Example: bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya\*\*\*\*.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the file system resides.
